title: NeuroForge Pipeline Manifest
description: Schema for YAML pipeline manifests. Each manifest describes how to invoke one containerized neuroimaging tool.

id.description: Unique identifier (snake_case). Used as a stable key in the database.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

description.description: Short plain-language description of what this pipeline does.

homepage.description: URL to the tool's official documentation.

image.description: Docker image name without tag (e.g. nipreps/mriqc).

digest.description: Optional SHA256 digest for fully reproducible pinning.

engine.description: Container engine. Only 'docker' is supported in v1.

execution.description: Native subprocess execution block. Use this instead of 'container' for tools installed directly in the backend image (e.g. via pip). Exactly one of 'container' or 'execution' must be present.

type.description: Execution type. 'native' runs the tool as a subprocess inside the backend container via NativeExecutor.

command.description: The CLI entry-point name (e.g. 'brainchop'). Must be on PATH inside the backend container.

outputs.description: Expected output directories relative to the derivatives root.

parameters.description: Ordered list of user-configurable parameters rendered in the run wizard.

max_runtime_hours.description: If set, the container is forcibly stopped after this many hours and the run is marked failed. Prevents indefinitely hung runs.

known_errors.description: Regex-based error patterns with plain-language explanations.

command_template.description: Template string for the Docker command. Use {placeholders} for dynamic values.

run_as_host_user.description: If true, containers.run() is called with user='<host-uid>:<host-gid>' so the container process runs as the same UID/GID as the host user. Required by images whose entrypoints refuse to run as an arbitrary non-root user (e.g. FastSurfer). Defaults to false; MRIQC and fMRIPrep do not need this.

dataset_positional.description: If true (default), the container command starts with the fixed positional pair '/data /out' and /data is mounted read-only to the BIDS dataset. If false, no positional prefix is emitted and /data is not mounted — used for flag-only pipelines like FastSurfer that address inputs via --flag mounts rather than a BIDS directory argument.

seed_output_from_lineage_artifact_type.description: Optional artifact type slug. When a run is launched from lineage carrying this artifact, NeuroForge copies the upstream artifact directory into this run's output_dir before execution. Used for tools whose official group-level mode expects a pre-populated output directory.

deprecated_params.description: Map of old param name → new param name for migration across manifest versions.

compute_profile.description: Expected local-execution quality. local-ok=runs well locally; local-slow=runs but significantly slower (e.g. Rosetta 2 emulation); local-unsafe=may hang indefinitely locally (e.g. AVX2 dependency).

category.description: Functional category for UI grouping and filtering. Choose the primary purpose of the tool.

input_type.description: Coarse classification of what raw data this pipeline expects. Used for UI filtering. dicom=raw scanner DICOMs; nifti=one or more .nii/.nii.gz files; bids_dataset=a BIDS-formatted directory.

accepts.description: Artifact types this pipeline can receive from a prior run. Each entry maps an artifact type to a parameter that the artifact path populates. Optional — pipelines without this field are standalone only.

produces.description: Artifact types this pipeline outputs. Used for chaining: downstream pipelines that accept a matching type can be pre-populated from this run's outputs. Optional.

type.description: Parameter value type, used to render the correct form control.

default.description: Default value; must be compatible with the parameter's type.

help.description: Plain-language explanation shown as a tooltip in the UI.

advanced.description: If true, the parameter is hidden under an 'Advanced options' disclosure.

positional_index.description: If set, this parameter is emitted as a positional CLI argument at the given position (1-based) after the fixed dataset/output args, rather than as a --flag value pair. Used for tools like MRIQC where analysis_level is positional.

multiple.description: If true and type is 'string', the user's space-separated input is split into multiple separate CLI arguments. Used for flags that accept repeated values (e.g. --participant-label 01 02 03).

cli_flag.description: Override the CLI flag emitted for this parameter. Use when the tool uses single-dash flags (e.g. '-b') rather than the default '--{name}' form. Include the dash(es) in the value.

positional_suffix.description: If true, this parameter is appended as a positional argument AFTER all flag arguments, using its container-internal path when mount:true. Used for tools like dcm2niix where the input directory is the last positional arg.

mount.description: If true and type is 'file_path' or 'directory_path', the path is bind-mounted into the container as a read-only volume and the CLI flag receives the container-internal path instead of the host path. Required for any file/directory that the container must read but that isn't the BIDS dataset or work-dir.

internal.description: If true, this parameter can receive manifest/lineage values but is not rendered in the UI and is never emitted as a CLI flag. Use for NeuroForge orchestration metadata, not tool arguments.

pattern.description: Python-compatible regex matched against stdout/stderr lines.

explanation.description: Plain-language explanation of what this error means.

fix_hint.description: Actionable suggestion for how to resolve the error.

type.description: Artifact type slug (must match a key in artifact_types.yaml).

param.description: Parameter name (from parameters[].name) that receives the artifact path when chaining. Must be present unless dataset_slot is true.

dataset_slot.description: If true, this artifact feeds the dataset selector rather than a named parameter. Used for BIDS-dataset pipelines (MRIQC, fMRIPrep) where the input dataset is chosen via RunCreate.dataset_id, not a param.

label.description: User-facing label shown in the 'Use as input to:' picker.

description.description: One-sentence description shown alongside the label.

required.description: If true, this accept slot must be filled before the pipeline can launch. All slots are optional by default — chaining is never mandatory.

type.description: Artifact type slug (must match a key in artifact_types.yaml).

path_hint.description: Glob pattern relative to output_dir for auto-discovery. Empty string means output_dir itself is the artifact (for directory-type outputs). Absent means the artifact cannot be auto-resolved — user must browse manually.

source_param.description: If set, the artifact path is taken from params[source_param] rather than resolved from output_dir. Used for semantic artifacts like bids_dataset_validated where the 'output' is the input dataset directory.

label.description: User-facing label shown in the 'Use Output' button and chaining UI.

description.description: One-sentence description of what this artifact is.

multiple.description: If true, path_hint may match multiple files (e.g. per-subject NIfTIs). The UI presents a file picker when multiple files are found.
